subject: Request: SOW carve + change order for pilot scale (add nodes & pricing)
messages:
From: Amelia Stone <amelia.stone@medisys.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: contracts@medisys.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot expansion — SOW carve + change order request

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To recap, MediSys wants to expand the pilot to include an additional 10 dedicated nodes (reserved GPU capacity) for the remainder of Q3. That will require a short SOW carve and a change order to the existing order form to update the capacity line items and the monthly fee.

What we need from Redwood to move forward:
- A clear change order document with the new quantities and monthly rates (we currently have SOW v1 attached).
- Confirmation on billing start date (we’d like it to align with 2028-07-01).
- Any required MSA amendments or redlines (we’re sensitive to data retention language and audit access).
- Estimated timeline for legal review and signing so we can submit a PO to our procurement team.

I attached the current SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf) and a one-page summary of the additional capacity. We can share a PO once we have the change order and an updated invoice cadence.

Can you pull together an internal playbook so we can get this through our procurement and contracts teams quickly?

Thanks,
Amelia Stone
Head of Cloud Ops
MediSys AI
amelia.stone@medisys.ai

Attachment: MediSys_Pilot_Expansion_Summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot expansion — SOW carve + change order request

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. We’re aligned on scope but will need a couple internal checks before sending a final change order:

1) Legal: redline the order form and confirm there are no MSA-level conflicts for the extended reserved capacity and data retention ask.
2) Finance: confirm billing start date and whether we can prorate July if activation occurs mid-month.
3) Delivery/Onboarding: validate implementation window for adding 10 nodes to the dedicated pool (estimated 5 business days).

Next steps from my side: I’ll create a draft change order and SOW carve that updates the capacity line items, proposed monthly fee, and an implementation timeline. I’ll route the draft to Karthik (legal) and Laura (commercial finance) for redline/review. Our target is to get a signable package to you by Friday, 2028-06-08, assuming quick internal turnaround.

If MediSys can provide a target PO number and any internal signatory requirements (e.g., DocuSign + procurement PO), that will help us prioritize.

Best,
Irene Choi

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot expansion — SOW carve + change order request

Irene / Laura — I reviewed Amelia’s ask and the initial draft SOW carve I pulled together. High-level notes and proposed redlines:

- Change order: include a new Exhibit ("Exhibit: Pilot Capacity Supplement") that references the existing order form and enumerates the 10 additional nodes as a line item with the per-node monthly rate and total monthly fee.
- Billing start date: Redwood prefers billing from the first day of the month the nodes are provisioned; we can offer a one-time pro rata credit if activation occurs after the 10th of the month. Proposed language: "Billing will commence on the first day of the month in which Redwood provisions the additional capacity unless otherwise agreed in writing."
- Data retention / audit access: do not change core MSA retention terms. Instead add a sentence in the SOW carve clarifying the specific logs/access MediSys needs for audit and propose a separate statement-of-work exhibit outlining agreed audit windows and costs if additional engineering support is required.
- SLA and performance: add an implementation acceptance test (7-day validation window) after provisioning before committing to full SLA uptime credits. This protects both sides during pilot ramp.
- Termination/rollback: include a 30-day notice for capacity de-provisioning to prevent immediate removal that could impact running jobs.

I’ve attached a redlined copy of the order form and SOW carve (Proposed_ChangeOrder_20280605.pdf). Please confirm:
1) Laura — is the proposed pro-rata credit language acceptable to finance? If not, suggest exact phrasing/amount.
2) Irene — once we agree, I’ll prepare the MSA amendment text and a short cover memo for Medisys’ contracts team.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Hi Irene,

Thanks — that read is sensible and mostly aligns with our expectations. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- PO number: PO-5921 (I’ve added it to this thread).
- Procurement wants billing to start 2028-07-01 and prefers full-month billing (no pro rata). If Redwood absolutely needs pro rata we can consider it, but that will slow approval on our side.

If you can send the final redlined change order (with the Exhibit and the implementation acceptance test language), we can get our contracts team to review quickly. We are happy to sign via DocuSign — here’s our preferred link: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/link/abc123-docsign
